title.narrative: Relief intervention to flood affected persons in communities of Adamawa state

description.narrative: This proposed project intends to respond to the basic needs of persons affected by flood across the 2 selected LGAs out of the 14 affected LGAs of Adamawa State. The project will reach out to an average of 1,200 Households (7,200 individuals) to be spread across the targeted locations. The targeted Households will be supported with both food and Nonfood items and unrestricted cash transfer. WASH promotion, Disaster risk Reduction messages/approaches, Psychosocial support and protection will be mainstream throughout the project phase. The WASH intervention is aimed at reducing the risk of the affected population from been exposed to harmful weather elements and related diseases such as cholera, skin infections, diarrhea etc. Mainstreaming Protection, disaster risk reduction approaches/messages and psychosocial support will reduce possible harm that might arise at the course of the project implementation on both the staff, beneficiaries and affiliates, support affected communities to develop strategic responses on mitigating further impact on the floods in their communities and adequately address their mental needs as a result of damage caused by the flood. The project will also conduct capacity building to communities and volunteers most especially on safeguarding related issues to minimize harm on both the beneficiaries and the project team. Use of information Education and communication materials will be adequately used to pass messages that will educate the beneficiaries of the project on issues such as basic hygiene process, Complain Reporting Mechanism and other approaches to mitigate and contain further disasters. The project will be deliberate to have active representation of women and persons living with disability. For the unrestricted cash transfer, food and non-food items during targeting, women will be given 70% priority.
